## Evidence from the gallery refresh · this item now blocks the gallery

Reading of the full gallery refresh on published **18.6.0** (2026-11-18, scratch mode, `--model opus`, all six generic starter cards, runner and grader from objectstack main `b1eb500dc7`). **No app exported. This item is the one failure every card shares.**

| Card | Confirmed write after the person said yes |
|:--|:--|
| asset_lifecycle `dispose_scrapped_asset` | 0/1 per half |
| order_to_cash | 0/1 per half |
| requisition_to_receipt | 0/1 per half |
| service_desk | 0/1 per half |
| travel_expense | 0/1 per half |
| leave_balances | not measured (the build's own lock) |

**The same refusal on every card:**
- `run_action` answers `428 ACTION_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED`, `reason: no_confirmation_service`: "This server has no pending-confirmation service to ask them through, and a confirmation sent on the request does not count."
- This is the 18.6 behaviour of #34358 and #34318.
- The agent behaves exactly as wanted every time: it asks first, explains that the confirmation must be given in the app, and does not route around the gate by writing the fields itself.

**Effect:**
- While this step grades `fail`, no card with a confirm-gated operation can pass all halves on 18.6.0 or later.
- So the gallery cannot refresh at all. `gallery-refresh` exports only all-pass cards, and five of the six cards are hit.
- Grading it `not measured`, as this card asks, unblocks the gallery. The ask half ("asked first") is still graded on every card.

Records: one per card, `/tmp/gallery-refresh/runs/2026-11-18-scenario-*.json` in the epic seat's session (available on request).
